# Pulse Hospital & I.C.U, Modasa

> Pulse Hospital & I.C.U (પલ્સ હોસ્પિટલ એન્ડ આઈ.સી.યુ.) is a 41-bed hospital for 24x7 emergency and critical care on the 4th floor of City Centre, Shamlaji Road, Modasa, Aravalli district, Gujarat, India. It has a 30-bed critical care department with ventilators, an in-house CT scan, a 24x7 dialysis unit, a 24x7 laboratory and pharmacy, and modular operation theatres, with MD physicians, a DM cardiologist and a chest physician.

## Contact
- Address: 4th Floor, A-block, City Centre, Shamlaji Road, Modasa, Aravalli - 383315, Gujarat, India
- Emergency, appointments and WhatsApp: +91 95120 45641 / +91 95120 45642
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/919512045641
- Emergency, ICU, dialysis, laboratory and pharmacy: open 24 hours, every day
- OPD: Mon – Sat · 09:00 AM – 01:30 PM & 04:30 PM – 08:00 PM
- Map: https://maps.google.com/?q=City+Centre+Shamlaji+Road+Modasa+Gujarat
- Website: https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/

## Main pages
- [Doctors](https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/doctors): 6 doctors with OPD timings
- [Departments](https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/departments): Critical Care & ICU, General & Internal Medicine, Heart & Cardio-Metabolic Care, Chest & Pulmonology, Kidney Care & Dialysis, Liver & Stomach (Gastro), Brain & Stroke Care, Emergency, Trauma & Poisoning, Surgery
- [Facilities](https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/facilities): ICU, emergency, dialysis, CT scan, laboratory, operation theatres, rooms and more
- [Intensive Care Unit (ICU)](https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/facilities/icu): 30-bed comprehensive critical care unit comprising 15 ICCU beds, 7 MICU beds, 7 SICU beds and 1 isolation bed with ventilators and central monitoring.
- [Emergency & Trauma](https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/facilities/emergency): A casualty desk with an immediate doctor response for accidents, poisoning, snakebite, burns, stroke and high fever.
- [24x7 Dialysis Unit](https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/facilities/dialysis): Emergency and scheduled haemodialysis, supported by high-grade dialysis machines and a dedicated RO water purification plant.
- [In-House CT Scan](https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/facilities/ct): Modasa CT Scan Centre on the same premises with high-precision gantry and technician workstation, requiring zero transfer delay.
- [Book an appointment](https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/book-appointment): choose a doctor, day and time; the request is sent on WhatsApp
- [Contact and directions](https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/contact)

Full details: https://bluenovatechin.github.io/Pulse-Hospital/llms-full.txt
